profile.name: Nisarg Shah
profile.description: Building data-driven solutions through statistical analysis, ML, and large-scale data processing, while exploring cloud, MLOps, and AI engineering.

featuredProjects.title: Uniswap V3 LP Position Profitability Prediction
featuredProjects.description: Predicts whether a Uniswap V3 liquidity position will be profitable at the moment it is opened, providing data-driven guidance on concentrated price-range selection. Built a leakage-safe ML pipeline on 62,250 closed positions extracted from 9 on-chain data sources across the highest-volume pools, with custom feature engineering for tick ranges, fee events, and partial withdrawal handling. Logistic Regression and XGBoost were evaluated with chronological train/test splitting to prevent temporal leakage, and SHAP was used to interpret predictions. A key finding was that positions whose ranges did not overlap the pool's recently traded price range were profitable only 23% of the time, compared with 60% when they did.

featuredProjects.title: Criteo CTR Prediction
featuredProjects.description: Implemented and benchmarked the same click-through-rate prediction workflow across three computing environments: a Docker-based PySpark cluster, an AWS EC2 Spark cluster, and single-machine scikit-learn. Built preprocessing pipelines for the Criteo 1M dataset handling median imputation, log transformations, feature hashing for high-cardinality categoricals, and sparse feature assembly. Trained Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and Gradient-Boosted Trees models with 2-fold cross-validation. The best model achieved a 0.537 PR-AUC against a 25.5% positive-class baseline, with benchmarks comparing execution characteristics across the single-machine and distributed setups.
